 JUDGMENT

This case is arose out of Crime No.0128/2016 of Airport Police Station registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 of IPC based on the gist of facts stated in the FIR which has set this criminal case in motion against the accused.

2. The case of the prosecution is that while accused working as Business Development Manager in the Trident Inter Wood Private Limited, Amarajyothi Layout, Inner Ring Road, Koramangala,
Bengaluru belonged to the ownership of complainant directly contacting the customers did the interior decoration of the houses by obtaining the order and obtained amount towards the worked down from the customers but he has concocted separate receipts of customers and meager amounts were shown in the receipt book - 3 -- CC-6251/2017 and thereby, he caused wrongful loss of Rs.18,76,790/- to the company belonged to the complainant.
3.

The Airport Police had booked the case against the accused- Solomon.M.K. and Thamarai Selvan for the offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 of IPC based on the written complaint of Sri. Hardeep Sawhney.
The Investigating Officer registered the FIR, prepared the spot and seizure panchanama, recorded the statement of witnesses and collected the documents.
Having material in the investigation, Investigating Officer filed charge sheet against the accused-Solomon.M.K. only for the offences alleged.
4. Upon receipt of the court summons, the accused has entered appearance before the court.
The relevant copies have been furnished under Section 207 of Cr. P.C. to the accused.
The charge for the offences under Sections 408 and 420 of IPC framed, explained and read over to the accused before the court.
Upon which accused has pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried before the court.
5. In the instant case, the prosecution examined CW9 as PW1, CW10 as PW2, CW7 as PW3, CW12 as PW4 and got marked Ex.P1 - 4 -- CC-6251/2017 to Ex.P4.

Despite issuing summons, warrants and proclamation warrants,
presence of CW1 to CW6, CW8, CW11, CW13 and CW14 were not secured.

Thereby, CW1 to CW6,
CW8, CW11, CW13 and CW14 were dropped from the charge sheet.
Evidence on prosecution side closed.
6. After closure of the prosecution evidence, the 313 statement was read over and explained to the accused in Kannada language.

The accused has denied the incriminating evidence available on Hardip Sahani vs Soloman M K on 6 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71141453/

As the findings to be given on particular point has the direct bearing on other points.
Therefore, so as to avoid the repetition of discussion and conclusion.
I have taken all these points for consideration at one stretch.

Hardeep Sawheny, who is Managing Director of Trident Inter Wood Private Limited,
Amarajyothi Layout, Inner Ring Road, Koramangala, Bengaluru lodged complaint against the accused- Solomon.M.K. and accused-Mr. Thamarai Selvan.
Police filed charge sheet against the accused-Solomon.M.K. Mr. Thamarai Selvan has been made as CW10 in the charge sheet.
12. Hardeep Sawheny did not step into the witness box in response to the summons, warrants and proclamation warrants issued by the court.
Therefore, Hardeep Sawheny-CW1 dropped from the charge sheet.
CW2-Shankaregowda and CW3- Narayanappa have been cited as witnesses who said to be the customers of complainant company.
These two witnesses also not not step into the witness box in response to the summons, warrants and proclamation warrants issued by the court.
CW4- R.Suresh Babu and CW5-Ravikumar have been cited as spot panchanama witnesses and CW6 has been cited as seizure panchanama witness.
Even these three witnesses did not step into the witness box in response to the summons, warrants and proclamation warrants issued by the court.
13. CW9-Shan has been examined as PW1 before the court.
Shan said to be received an amount of Rs.3 Lakhs as hand loan from his brother accused Solomon.
M.K. PW1 pleaded ignorance about the case.
He has been declared as hostile witness.
During the cross- examination by Senior Assistant Public Prosecutor, he has not given any evidence against the accused-Solomon.M.K.
14. CW10-Thamarai Selvan has been examined as PW2.

Hardeep Sawheny, who is Managing Director of Trident Inter Wood Private Limited, Amarajyothi Layout, Inner Ring Road,
Koramangala, Bengaluru lodged complaint against Solomon.M.K. and -Thamarai Selvan.
Police have not filed charge sheeted against Thamarai Selvan.
Police made Thamarai Selvan as witness of prosecution case.
PW2 has not given any evidence against the accused Solomon.M.K.
he has been declared as hostile witness.
During the cross-examination by the learned Sr. APP this witness completely resile from the contents of his previous statement.
15. One of the seizure panchanama witness CW7-Ramesh has been examined as PW3.
PW3 said that police took his signature on a document when he had been to the police station for his - 8 -- CC-6251/2017 personal work.
During the cross-examination by the learned Sr. APP he has not given any evidence supporting the seizure panchanama.
PW4 who said to be served as police constable in the old Airport Police Station testified that CW13, CW14 and himself brought the accused from his house to the police station.
CW6, CW8, CW11, CW13-witnesses and CW14- Investigating Officer did not step into the witness box in response to the summons, warrants and proclamation warrants issued by the court.

Thereby, those witnesses have been dropped from the Hardip Sahani vs Soloman M K on 6 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71141453/

16. The prosecution is not able to prove that accused has committed the offence of cheating or criminal breach of trust.
Accordingly, accused is entitled for acquittal of the offences alleged.

Hence,
I record findings on Point No.1 and 2 in the NEGATIVE.

17. Point No.3:- For the reasons discussed in the Point No.1 and 2, I pass the following:
ORDER
In exercise of power conferred under Section 248(1) of Cr. P.C. accused found not guilty of the - 9 -- CC-6251/2017 offences punishable under Sections 408 and 420 of IPC.

The bail bond and surety bond of the accused is extended for a period of 6 months in compliance of Section 437(A) of Cr. P.C. (Dictated to the Stenographer directly on the computer, typed by him, corrected by me and then pronounced by me in the open Court on this the 6th day of December 2025)
